blind.description: A two-tiered classical stone fountain composed of a low, wide circular ground basin with sculpted relief arches along its exterior wall, a square-based central pedestal with carved leaf/petal accents, a fluted scalloped upper basin, and a stylized flower-bud central finial/spout. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with detailed aged limestone/sandstone texturing.
blind.from_above: Concentric stone rings resembling a stylized flower or cogwheel, showing the scalloped upper basin centered inside the larger circular lower basin with a bud finial in the middle.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 4.5 feet wide across the base basin.
